QUOTE: The index's own inventory notes that a file whose extension no grammar handles is not indexed at all, so "in scope" and "indexed" are not the same set.
VERDICT: MISS
WHY: The answer says in-scope is not the same as indexed, but it names neither the parse-built front end claiming file types doxygen can't read nor binary classification dropping files with misleading extensions. The "no grammar handles the extension" remark is a different mechanism.
